For colleagues

A new era for teachers

A course about the new era of teaching, drawn from my own experience. For teachers of more than just Swedish, and of more than just languages.

Mini-course for teachers

[Don’t] call me “Miss”

This course is about what teaching is becoming in the new era: methodology that doesn’t put people to sleep, the teacher’s psychology, a brand on Instagram, selling without the awkwardness, and a system that holds it all together. One of the modules is about impostor syndrome – a subject I know from my own experience rather than from a textbook. This isn’t only about Swedish but about teaching languages in general – and most of all about my own mistakes. The aim is simple: to save you from walking the same road – take what has already worked, and find your own.

Do you teach Swedish? Write to me about joint projects

If you teach Swedish and you’re interested in working together, write to me. Tell me a little about yourself: your experience, what kind of students you work with and what interests you. I’ll reply, and we’ll work out together whether we have something to talk about.
